title: Robert Braucher Visiting Professor of Law
bio: Nicolas Cornell, professor of law at the University of Michigan, teaches and writes in the areas of contracts, property, moral philosophy, remedies, and private law theory. Cornell’s work seeks to connect issues in normative ethics with questions about the foundations of private law doctrine.
